One more day in Cusco… then a solo detour 🇵🇪
A little location update from Peru: I’m spending one more day in Cusco , before heading off on a short solo detour to Arequipa .
After that, the plan is to return to Lima , then continue to Ica . A few different chapters ahead!

In the meantime, there’s something new to explore on the website: 33 photographs from Lima, Cusco, the Inca Trail and Machu Picchu . City evenings, mountain paths and plenty of moments worth a closer look.
Have you been to Arequipa or Ica? Hit reply with one place, dish or experience you think I should know about. I’d love to hear your tips.
P.S. Enjoying these little Postcards? You can buy me a coffee to support the journey and the stories I share. Always optional, always appreciated. ☕
See you on the scenic route, Dainyel
